checked_ranges.chosen_9339: 17.0-20.4 @0.2 (researcher window), 0.0-3.4 @0.2, 11.0-14.6 @0.2, 27.0-30.4 @0.2, 40.4-44.0 @0.2, 0-51 @3.0 overview; per-window motion energy measured at 5fps over the whole clip

findings.content: Hand, paper, ballpoint only. Steady locked-off top-down close-up, 16:9 720p source, no crop needed. No face, no text, no logo, no watermark anywhere in 0-53s. No acting toward camera.
findings.in_point_change: Researcher's 17.0-20.4 is the most static stretch of the clip (hand parked at the brain stem, only a pen-tip wiggle; motion energy 48 vs clip max 79). Moved to 11.4-14.6: hatching strokes at the right edge of the drawing 11.4-12.2, a soft natural reposition of the hand down to the stem 12.4-12.8, then continuous hatching through 14.6. Reads as drawing from the first frame and the drawing is less filled-in here than at 17s or 40s, which is closer to the brief's 'simple explanatory lines'. 40.6-43.8 has even more motion but the sketch is fully hatched (more 'artwork').
findings.first_frame: 11.4s: hand at right, pen tip on paper, brain outline centre-left. Scene reads instantly.
findings.motion: Continuous through 11.4-14.6 with no freeze; one gentle hand travel at ~12.5s, otherwise small stroke motion. Adequate for a 3.2s hold.
findings.tone: Main weakness. Flat neutral-to-cool lightbox white, no desk or environment, saturated blue pen; it is the opposite of warm film-like desk light and the brain sketch is more 'artist illustration' than 'explanatory line'. Approved only on condition of a grade: warm the white balance (~+15 to +20), pull global saturation down so the pen sits slate-blue, add a light vignette/lifted blacks to match the film look of the neighbouring shots. Without that grade this cut will pop out of the sequence.

alternates_verdict.36721: Rejected as primary. Best colour match (warm window light, denim sleeve, shallow DOF) but it is a canvas on an easel, not paper on a desk, the pencil barely moves in 13s and the hand is soft-focused. Violates the brief's 'must not look like an artwork' more than the chosen clip. Could serve as a dissolve/texture layer only.
alternates_verdict.30232: Rejected. Handheld macro on a pencil portrait: jittery, repeatedly out of focus, whip-pan at ~8s, saturated blue pencil, subject is fine-art hair shading.
alternates_verdict.50110: Best tonal and brief match in the folder (warm desk lamp, beige palette, black fineliner drawing straight geometric lines on grid paper) but fails the text rule: printed sweatshirt text 'THE CREATIVE COLLECTIVE' in frame 0-1.8s, and a textbook with legible printed Spanish math text enters bottom-left from ~2.6s and is fully readable by 3.2-4.0s. No 3.2s window is clean without a heavy punch-in.

grade_notes: WB +15..20 warm, saturation -25..-35 (target: pen slate/grey-blue, paper cream), slight vignette, lift blacks to film curve. No crop. Cut 11.4-14.6.
decision: Approve 9339 with a mandatory warm/desaturating grade and the in-point moved to 11.4s. Nothing in the library beats it on the hard rules (no face, no text, hand+paper+pen only, steady, real motion); its only failures are tonal and correctable.
